name: Config Revision
description: Allows to create revision for the config entities.
project_description: Config Revision adds a revision history to configuration entities. Drupal's content entities have revisions but configuration entities do not, so a bad config edit is hard to review or undo without config-sync tooling. This module defines a lightweight, bundleable, non-translatable content entity (config_revision) whose bundles (config_revision_type) map one-to-one to the config entity types you opt in on the settings form. Every time an enabled config entity is saved a new revision is recorded (via hook_entity_insert / hook_entity_update); deleting the config entity deletes its revision record. Administrators can view the revision history, see an inline YAML diff between the current config and a stored revision, and revert the live config to a stored revision. Changes made during config import are ignored. The revision UI relies on core issue #2350939 for full functionality.
